newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsubishi Motors produces mini buses in Vietnam.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Motors produces mini buses in Vietnam.

text.p: Japanese carmaker Mitsubishi Motors Corp said on Tuesday its joint venture in Vietnam started production of mini buses in February.
The factory near Ho Chi Minh City has an annual production capacity of 5,000 vehicles and assembles the Mitsubishi Delica Minibus (L300), Mitsubishi Motors said in a statement.
It did not say why it had delayed in announcing the start of production.

The joint venture, Vina Star Motors Corp, was set up by Mitsubishi Motors, trading house Mitsubishi Corp, Perusahaan Otomobil Nasional Bhd (Proton) of Malaysia and Vietnamese state enterprise TracimexCo, Mitsubishi Motors said.
The venture is capitalised at $16 million and the four each have a 25 percent stake in it, the company said.
